title: Squad needs for Fader
description:
These need to be completed ahead of time. There is no specific person to take care of these, but they all need to be covered

-  [x] Alter to summon him. The Vegvisir will be found in either Charred Fortresses or Charred Ruins.
-  [ ] Three [[color:rare+icon]Bells[/color]](https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Bell) for the summoning process. ([[color:rare+icon]Bell Fragment[/color]](https://valheim.fandom.com/wiki/Bell_Fragment) get combined into a Bell in a Black forge)
-  [ ] A lot of [color:rare+icon]Fire resistance barley wine[/color] (The total number depends on how many people are expected to show up and to have the effect the entire fight)
-  [ ] A lot of [color:rare+icon]Basalt Bomb[/color] (Depends on how many people but probably only need them for emergencies)
-  [x] A protected **portal** near the fight *(floor 3 of the portal vault called "the emerald flame")*
-  [ ] A plethora of [color:blue]frost[/color] and [color:green]poison[/color] arrows
-  [ ] Get a headcount of who needs armor
-  [ ] Get a headcount of who needs weapons
-  [ ] Good food for [color:red]health[/color], [color:yellow]stamina[/color], and [color:purple]etier[/color]
-  [ ] [color:red]Health[/color] and [color:yellow]stamina[/color] meads

We still to find the Alter to summon him.

We need to get three Bells for the summoning process.

Attack types to focus on:
  - Neutral to Blunt, Slach, Frost, Lightning, and Poison
  - Resistant to Pierce
  - Immune to Fire, Spirit, Chop, Pickaxe

This makes me think:
Ranged: Pick arrows that do statuses like lightning/frost/poison
Magic: Pick the frost or lightning staff for direct damage. Any soul staff should work to do other damage but check the entity damage type
Melee: Focus on Maces/Hammers, Swords, or Lightning/Frost status weapons to - We still to find the Alter to summon him.
- We need to get three Bells for the summoning process. (Fragments get combined into a Bell somehow)
- A lot of fire resist mead
- A lot of platform bombs (or whatever they are called)
- A protected portal near the fight
- A plethora of fire and poison arrows
- Get a headcount of who needs armor 
- Get a headcount of who needs weapons
- Good food for health, stamina, and etier
- Health and stamina meads
